title: Test speed: split multi-run loops and internal thread pools in motion heavy lib tests

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:medium
labels.description: One module or crate, a known pattern (issue-worker-medium)

body:
`motion heavy: lib` took 752 s on `dude` (`ea0646853`).
It stopped early at 232 s on Hetzner ccx43 (`8643d9bb7`) from a blocked #1950 test.

We timed all 10 `#[ignore]` tests in `camcraft-motion --lib` in release (serial sum 945.13 s).
Four multi-case tests take 844.6 s (89.4% of the binary):
- `budget::twins::the_r7_bars_levels_decide_the_same_way_under_sub_micron_perturbations` (`budget_twins.rs:111`): 353.44 s; spawns 5 internal threads.
- `adaptive::tests::the_slot_keeps_its_verdict_under_sub_micron_perturbations` (`adaptive/tests.rs:118`): 201.28 s; runs 20 slot plans in one serial loop.
- `budget::twins::the_windows_levels_decide_the_same_way_under_sub_micron_perturbations` (`budget_twins.rs:125`): 197.02 s; spawns 5 internal threads.
- `adaptive_troch::tests::l_shaped_pocket_is_cleared_under_engagement_limit` (`adaptive_troch_tests.rs:332`): 92.86 s; runs two `check_cleared` cases (`D10` and `D6`) serially.

Inside a 2-thread gate lane, the two `budget_twins` tests can run together and spawn 10 threads while 7 other lanes run.

What to do:
1. Split each perturbation in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive/budget_twins.rs` (`TWINS_NM = [0.0, 8.0, 16.0, 62.0, 250.0]`) into its own `#[test]` function.
2. Remove the internal `std::thread::scope` pool in `budget_twins.rs`.
3. Split `the_slot_keeps_its_verdict_under_sub_micron_perturbations` in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive/tests.rs` into separate `#[test]` functions (one per perturbation or small groups).
4. Split `l_shaped_pocket_is_cleared_under_engagement_limit` in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive_troch_tests.rs` into separate D10 and D6 `#[test]` functions.
5. Keep every perturbation value and every assertion unchanged.

Done means:
- No heavy test in `camcraft-motion --lib` spawns an internal thread pool.
- No heavy test runs 20 full plans serially in one function.
- Every perturbation and assertion passes under `cargo test --release -p camcraft-motion --lib -- --ignored`.
- The `#[test]` count increases accordingly.

Part of #2556
